reason: Accuracy audit of all 37,396 saved pairs (29,741 Old Testament, 7,655 New Testament) against the pinned Saints-Translation source and the staging site. One rationale described a detail that lies outside its cited target range.

corrections.before: Wisdom celebrates salvation even when the traveler lacks skill; the psalm likewise makes rescue depend on the Lord's response and guidance when sailors' wisdom has failed.
corrections.after: Wisdom celebrates salvation even when the traveler lacks skill; the psalm likewise shows the Lord bringing distressed seafarers out of the storm, stilling the waves and guiding them to harbor in answer to their cry.
corrections.evidence: “All their wisdom was swallowed up” is Psalms 106:27, outside the cited range 106:28-30. The cited verses state the cry, the stilled storm and the guidance to harbor; the target range, hashes and relationship are unchanged.
